Messages.Author: Smiling Tom, The Anarch
Messages.Body:
Guess what... It has happened again: In an Anarch precon deck, here it comes
Lambach Advanced. Just like xaviar did some months ago.

A guy from barcelona has published its stats in our vtes yahoo forum, hope
soon he'll scan it

Lambach
Tzimice
10 capacity, pre ANI AUS DOM VIC
Advanced, Independent: Lambach has 2 votes. He can equip with the
Eye of Hazimel at no cost from your library as a +1 stealth action
(shuffle afterward).
MERGE: He untaps when he successfully performs an action to put a
vampire in play.

Wow. The merged plus the eye for free, +2 strength. pre ANI AUS POT DOM CHI
VIC, aggro ability. Guess the merged is relative to embrace or alike cards.
Or the storyline-relative card, can't remember the name

"If the advancement card conflicts with the base card (a different sect,
for example), the advancement card has precedence. "

So he's Independent.

Which means:

>Does the 2 votes of the Advanced Lambach override
>the Cardinal of the basic Lambach,

A vampire can only have one title, and yields the other.

You cannot be a Cardinal and Independent, anyway.

"Only Sabbat vampires can become bishops, archbishops, prisci or
cardinals." [10.2]

>do they add together,

As an Independent vampire, So-and-so has 2 votes is a title. You cannot
have two titles.

>or what? And
>is he Sabbat or Independant?

Independent.

>Is it based on which one was in play
>first?

No. Where base and advanced version conflict on these matters, advanced
takes precedence.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <93148a54.03061...@posting.google.com>, Darky

<jja....@hccnet.nl> writes:
>If you make him sabbat though, you can choose him to be cardinal,
>giving up the 2 votes he had when he was independent.

Changing sect only would allow you to do that - the title would go
dormant.

If you gain a new title, however, you automatically give up the old
title - whether it was dormant or not. It's not there for you to claim
when you go back to being Sabbat.

Messages.Author: salem
Messages.Body:
On 14 Jun 2003 02:33:23 -0700, jja....@hccnet.nl (Darky) scrawled:



You can only ever have one title. If you merge Lambach^ up onto
Lambach, then Lambach[[] is independant with a title (2 votes). This
title will displace Lambach's cardinal title. If Lambach[[] then
becomes Sabbat, he will not have a cardinal title to re-gain the
effects of. He will still have his (2 votes) title, which is not
dependant on sect.
You could call a Cardinal Benediction on him, though, if you had
turned Lambach[[] Sabbat. If it passed, the Cardinal title would
displace the (2 votes) title.

Messages.Author: The Fanboy
Messages.Body:
>Guess he's pretty much given up on the Sabbat...couldn't blame him
>though! ;)

Well, from Children of the Inquisition (or was it Kindred Most
Wanted), we learn that Lambach is probably the only Tzimice that knew
his Antideluvian was not diablerized. Then, he encounters that same
Antedeluvian beneath New York City during the seige of NYC (Nights of
Prophecy). This is probably where he became aware of the Eye, as
well.

The Sabbat exists to destroy th Antedeluvians, not be the pawns of
them. He's now using the Eye (which from the Storyline fiction piece
tells us is controlled by the Tzimice Antedeluvian) to create a legion
of Tzimice loyal only to him (and through him, the Antedeluvian).
That pretty much goes against everything the Sabbat stands for.

I had predicted when they announced the tournament that the Advanced
Lambach would be Independent. Glad to know I was right for a change.
*chuckle*

Fanboy
